% ---- Q1 ----
1)

\underline{Question 1: The Gadget Maker}

Orbit's strongest claim is cover damages under the sale-of-goods rules. Glimmer breached by delivering 200 of 500 sprockets, and Orbit covered 300 at \$6 versus \$4, so the difference is \$600 plus foreseeable resale losses (100\% of that is recoverable if foreseeable).

Glimmer's best defense is impracticability. Here, the flood closed its only factory, a failure of a basic assumption; but Glimmer must allocate remaining capacity fairly \& notify Orbit. A\_B testing is irrelevant. See § 2-615 \{fictional\} \~{} 1990–2000.
